v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Allelúia, * Dóminus regnávit, decórem índuit, allelúia, allelúia.
text.en: Alleluia, * The Lord hath reigned, he is clothed with beauty, alleluia, alleluia.
Shout with joy to God * all the earth, alleluia.

text.la: Benedícam te * in vita mea, Dómine: et in nómine tuo levábo manus meas, allelúia.
text.en: I will bless thee all my life long * and in thy name I will lift up my hands, alleluia.

text.la: Tres púeri * iussu regis in fornácem missi sunt, non timéntes flammam ignis, dicéntes: Benedíctus Deus, allelúia.
text.en: The three young boys * cast into the furnace by the king, fearing not the flames of fire, said: Blessed be God, alleluia.

text.la: Allelúia, * laudáte Dóminum de cælis, allelúia, allelúia.
text.en: Alleluia, * praise ye the Lord from the heavens, alleluia, alleluia.

text.la: Benedíctio, et cláritas, et sapiéntia, et gratiárum áctio, honor, virtus, et fortitúdo Deo nostro in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
text.en: Benediction, and glory, and wisdom, and thanksgiving, honour, and power, and strength to our God for ever and ever. Amen.

v.en: The Lord reigns, he is clothed with beauty.

r.la: Índuit Dóminus fortitúdinem, et præcínxit se virtúte.
r.en: The Lord is clothed with strength, and has girded Himself with power.

text.la: Erat quidam régulus, * cuius fílius infirmabátur Caphárnaum. Hic cum audísset quod Iesus veníret in Galilǽam, rogábat eum ut sanáret fílium eius.
text.en: There was a certain nobleman whose son was sick * at Capernaum. When he heard that Jesus was come into Galilee, he besought Him that He would heal his son.

text.la: Largíre, quǽsumus, Dómine, fidélibus tuis indulgéntiam placátus et pacem: ut páriter ab ómnibus mundéntur offénsis, et secúra tibi mente desérviant.
text.en: Grant, we beseech thee, O Lord, to thy faithful people pardon and peace, that they may be cleansed from all their sins, and serve thee with a quiet mind.

text.la: Sancta María, succúrre míseris, iuva pusillánimes, réfove flébiles, ora pro pópulo, intérveni pro clero, intercéde pro devóto femíneo sexu: séntiant omnes tuum iuvámen, quicúmque célebrant tuam admirábilem Maternitátem.
text.en: Holy Mary show thine aid to those in misery, strengthen the faint-hearted, comfort the sorrowful, pray for the people, mediate for the clergy, intercede for all women vowed to God; may all experience thy help who celebrate thy admirable Motherhood.

v.la: Germinávit radix Iesse; orta est stella ex Iacob.
v.en: The Root of Jesse hath budded; the Star hath risen out of Jacob.

r.la: Virgo péperit Salvatórem: te laudámus Deus noster.
r.en: A Virgin hath brought forth the Saviour: O Lord our God, we praise thee.

text.la: Deus, qui de beátæ Maríæ Vírginis útero Verbum tuum, Angelo nuntiánte, carnem suscípere voluísti: præsta supplícibus tuis: ut qui vere eam Genetrícem Dei crédimus, eius apud te intercessiónibus adiuvémur.
text.en: O God, who didst will that, at the announcement of an Angel, thy Word should take flesh in the womb of the Blessed Virgin Mary, grant to us thy suppliants, that we who believe her to be truly the Mother of God may be helped by her intercession with thee.

office.title: Dominica XX Post Pentecosten II. Octobris
